Anya: Noticed p95 jump on the compile+cuda-graph path when mini-batches contain mixed seqlens around the 480-540 range.
Anya: Profiling shows repeated cudagraph re-captures and KV cache rebinding per request. Dump below.
Anya: nsight snippet:
```
kernel_selector: lookup(key=(arch=sm80, seqlen=512, batch=2, compile=yes)) -> matmul_tiled_v2
cuda_graph: capture_attempt -> success
cuda_graph: next_request(seqlen=520) -> capture_mismatch -> recapture
kv_cache: rebind_count=5
thread_pool: warmup_ops repeated
```
Priya: Wait, mixed seqlens in same microbatch? Our batcher packs variable seqlens, padding to max. Why would capture mismatch happen if padded shapes match capture shape?
Kevin: Because torch.compile can produce dynamic loop unrolling depending on input conditionals. Even with padding, generated graph can differ if we take different code paths (attention optimization toggles). That changes kernel signature keys we use.
Sasha: Confirmed. The kernel key includes an instruction count hash from the graph IR; compile-time optimizations differ for seqlen buckets so keys flip.
Mike: Hmm. Two angles: (A) make kernel key ignore compile-IR hash for cudagraph-eligible captures; (B) make batcher stable by grouping by capture-fingerprint + seqlen bucket.
Anya: (A) seems lower-risk to test quickly. (B) may reduce packing efficiency.
Priya: Also observed KV churn correlates with minibatch boundaries where one request falls into different bucket than previous capture. We should delay KV eviction until a few consecutive mismatches.
Kevin: Prototype plan: change kernel key to include a 'capture-stability' bit: if torch.compile enabled, only use arch+seqlen+batching heuristics, ignore IR hash. Add metrics for 'capture_mismatch_rate'.
Sasha: I'll add a smoothing timer: when capture mismatch occurs, mark the KV binding 'soft-invalid' and allow up to N=3 subsequent attempts before evicting. This avoids evict storms from noisy mismatches.
Mike: Can we get a repro script that simulates mixed seqlen microbatches and toggles compile flags? If we can reproduce locally, we can run full nsight traces.
Anya: I'm attaching a tiny runner repro in /tmp/ci-repros/1945-compile-kvchurn.tar.gz and a flamegraph. Repro steps in README.
PerfBot: alert: model=redwood-open-7b p95 latency increased 90% on runner-stable-x86-gpu cluster at 2026-11-09T07:12:10Z.
Priya: Quick mitigation: set RW_BATCHER_PAD_STRATEGY=per_request to force per-request padding so captures match; cost hit ~3% tail tokens but stops recapture storms.
Kevin: Rollout notes: can flip kernel-key change behind a flag RW_KERNEL_STABLE_OVERRIDE for 1% of traffic. Sasha, coordinate KV smoothing rollout with me.
Sasha: Will PR KV smoothing today; adding unit tests that simulate mis-capture sequences.
Anya: Thanks. I'll monitor capture_mismatch_rate and kv_rebind_count in the console and post updates. :thumbsup:
